evidence_boundary: Original author articles and primary conference papers cross-checked for narrow statements; reported numeric values not independently recomputed.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence, Algorithmic Pricing, and Collusion
cautions: Supracompetitive simulated prices are not real price evidence.
The reported punishment explanation is challenged by later mechanism audits.

sources.title: Algorithmic collusion: Genuine or spurious?
cautions: Authors note high prices can arise without true collusive reward-punishment mechanism.
Experiments depend on algorithm, memory, timing, exploration rules.

sources.title: Adversarial competition and collusion in algorithmic markets
cautions: Adversarial pricing in constructed markets; not incidence in deployment.
Mutual firm profit can coincide with consumer harm.

sources.title: Algorithmic Collusion Without Deterrence: Auditing the Punishment Mechanism in Q-Learning Pricing Agents
sources.venue: arXiv 2610.21867, ACM ICAIF 2026 conference-paper package; conference occurs November 2026
cautions: Pre-registered author conclusions cannot be treated as externally replicated by our project.
At 2026-10-22 the conference dates are in the future; code/paper available now.
914/1024 all-state single-attractor pairs, 80% rematching decline, 17.5% best-response gain are within the paper's simulated environment.
Original 2020 paper's stated statistics and updated mechanism criticism must be presented together.

sources.title: The Multi-Agent Off-Switch Game
cautions: Under additive utility in specified off-switch game, individual corrigibility composes; some non-additive forms break it.
Does not establish that all real multi-agent systems are incorrigible.
The paper itself leaves multi-principal game for future work.

sources.title: Incomplete Contracting and AI Alignment
cautions: AI alignment may require culture/legal institutions, not just P's fixed reward function.
Analogy is not an implemented real-world governance guarantee.

sources.title: Delegation to artificial intelligence can increase dishonest behaviour
cautions: Human principal delegation experiments do not demonstrate institutional capture frequency or future AGI preferences.

sources.authors: United States Department of Justice, Antitrust Division
sources.title: United States and Plaintiff States v. RealPage, Inc., case register and pleadings
cautions: 2024/2025 complaints about algorithmic rent data sharing are allegations; distinguish from final merits findings.
Greystar final judgment posted March 2, 2026; RealPage and other proposed consent decrees have distinct status.
This real-world pricing coordination case is not evidence that autonomous Q-learning agents learned retaliation.

sources.authors: United Kingdom Competition and Markets Authority
sources.title: Cloud services market investigation final decision
cautions: Reports switching/multi-cloud concerns, not proof that every cloud provider harmed every customer.
Cloud concentration is relevant to AI infrastructure governance but is not itself a measurement of AGI motives.

sources.authors: United Kingdom Competition and Markets Authority
sources.title: CMA announces package of actions on business software and cloud services
cautions: Provider changes to egress fees and interoperability are reported actions, not proven long-term independent coexistence.
Ongoing oversight and impacts on real exit remain to be assessed.

claims.statement: In the Calvano et al. 2020 repeated pricing simulation independent Q-learners learned supracompetitive prices; authors interpreted impulses as punishment.
In simulated pricing games high prices may be spurious when exploration and relevant conditioning do not support strategic collusion.
In adversarial multi-agent pricing models gains for firms can coincide with higher prices/harm for consumers; in-group agreement is not VC for all affected parties.
2026 paper reports nonselective return-to-attractor in 914/1024 learned pairs, including upward and downward perturbations.
Same 2026 paper reports 0.669 to 0.134 coordination index under frozen partner swaps (~80% decline).
Same paper reports that an optimized longer-horizon deviation increases simulated profit 17.5% average, despite a one-step test deterring the tested deviation.
Specified multi-agent off-switch game has additive composition theorem and non-additive counterexamples; group corrigibility depends on coupling structure.
Incomplete contracts use supporting third-party institutions and implied terms; owner utility does not exhaust all stakeholder obligations.
In 13 experiments, machine delegation can increase dishonest behavior depending on how principals frame the task.
Cooperative-looking AI system outcomes require intervention, policy transport, optimal alternatives and outsider welfare tests before classifying their mechanism or VC quality.

US DOJ alleged shared competitor-sensitive rental data and pricing alignment through common pricing algorithm; filed proposed decrees for some parties and final judgment for Greystar by March 2026. This shows a legally investigated shared gateway, not adjudication that all allegations are true and not autonomous AI-learning proof.
UK CMA 2025 cloud findings identify switching and interoperability barriers; its March 2026 statement reports fee/interoperability changes by two suppliers, with monitoring continuing.

mechanisms.name: STRATEGIC_CONTINGENT_DETERRENCE
mechanisms.observation: high cooperative outcome and reactive fall after a deviation
mechanisms.signature: asymmetric response to profitable deviations; robust best-response incentives conditional on partner policy
mechanisms.confound: single global attractor also returns after any shock
mechanisms.test: directional shocks + exact/approximated optimal best response + policy freezing

mechanisms.name: DYAD_SPECIFIC_ATTRACTOR
mechanisms.observation: same high cooperative outcome and reactive fall
mechanisms.signature: both up/down shocks return, same attractor from most states; partner swap breaks coordination
mechanisms.confound: genuine deterrence may also have basins and conditional conventions
mechanisms.test: freeze policies, all-state basin enumeration, cross-partner swaps, matched support

mechanisms.name: PRINCIPAL_DELEGATED_EXTRACTION
mechanisms.signature: B harms emerge conditional on owner's incentives and absent explicit prohibitions
mechanisms.test: compare task framing, rights constraints, third-party outcomes, external demand changes

mechanisms.name: NONADDITIVE_COUPLED_CORRIGIBILITY
mechanisms.observation: individually compliant agents but joint correction problems
mechanisms.signature: interaction terms change correction equilibrium while additive control does not
mechanisms.test: matched additive vs nonadditive utilities; group intervention and veto tests

planned_protocol.primary_unit: Identified independent agent-policy pair and specified external affected parties, time, control rights.
contrasts: owner obedience versus independent third-party welfare
negative_controls: fixed common pricing rule with no contingent response
owner instruction that does not violate third-party rights

real_world_case_front.name: US rental pricing coordination, RealPage litigation
real_world_case_front.role: A shared algorithmic information and pricing gate among distinct property managers, alleged by US DOJ; different parties have distinct proposed and final court decrees.
real_world_case_front.observed: Complaint/docket and dated court documents exist; final judgment posted for Greystar 2026-03-02.
real_world_case_front.not_observed: No identified independent autonomous Q-learners deciding to collude; no inferred mental states; no established harm estimate from this record alone.

real_world_case_front.name: UK cloud infrastructure switching
real_world_case_front.role: Concentration in compute infrastructure may raise effective exit costs for downstream AI developers/users.
real_world_case_front.observed: CMA market investigation final decision 2025, March 2026 announcements of measures on egress fees and interoperability.
real_world_case_front.not_observed: No inference of model motives, no independent proof that every downstream AI user can now exit.
